description:
We are seeking a dedicated Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to significantly impact patient care and staff development within a supportive environment. If you are a compassionate and skilled nursing professional looking to advance your career, we encourage you to apply.

As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in overseeing daily nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of care, and supporting the Director of Nursing. This position is ideal for an experienced Registered Nurse who is ready to take on greater leadership responsibilities and contribute to a positive and effective clinical team.

We are offering an attractive annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000 for this full-time position. Join a team committed to excellence and make a difference in the lives of residents.
requirements: Previous experience in a leadership or supervisory nursing role, preferably in a skilled nursing facility
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
Knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, based on experience and qualifications.
